header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.5.5: fixed crystal-surf spawning the end crystal with the ITEM id (end_crystal) instead of the ENTITY id (ender_crystal) — the resulting unhandled promise rejections interrupted movement every few seconds (bot froze / got stuck at edges); chain-speed tracker also never matched crystals for the same reason; async calls (surf/anchor/detonate/threat-defense) now always have rejection handlers. v0.5.4: hard preset keeps 0-value cooldowns; stuck detection counts jump-in-place so hole escape works; blast-mitigation block spam tamed; post-dive navigation reset; hard bowDistance 10. v0.5.3: removed un-namespaced "bot" registration (NoNamespace); /bot resolves via pvpbot:bot alias. v0.5.2: /bot caller resolved from CustomCommandOrigin.sourceEntity.
